The synthetic frame-energy surrogate is not findsylls, substitutes for no gate and cannot qualify the candidate. All eight release gates remain blocked.

rate_profile.requirement_text: Measure source/output mapping, duration, pitch, transient audibility and playback buffering. Include 1x, rate changes, unfamiliar speech, music, silence, rebuffer, drift and the final partial window. Keep pause or filler decisions tied to source timestamps and measure speech preservation.
